description: This file contains testing utilities, test vectors, and key generation functions for RSA blind signatures within the anonymous_tokens project. It defines data structures, cryptographic test functions, and constants used for testing RSA blind signature schemes, including IETF standard vectors and public metadata test vectors.

classes.name: IetfStandardRsaBlindSignatureTestVector
classes.description: Structure holding RSA blind signature test vector components as strings.

classes.name: IetfRsaBlindSignatureWithPublicMetadataTestVector
classes.description: Structure holding RSA blind signature test vector with public metadata components as strings.

methods.name: CreateTestKey
methods.description: Creates a test RSA key pair and public key with specified parameters.

methods.name: EncodeMessageForTests
methods.description: Prepares a message for signing by hashing and applying PSS padding, skipping message blinding.

methods.name: TestSign
methods.description: Signs blinded data with RSA key for testing purposes.

methods.name: TestSignWithPublicMetadata
methods.description: Signs blinded data with public metadata for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetStandardRsaKeyPair
methods.description: Generates a standard RSA key pair with specified modulus size.

methods.name: GetStrongRsaKeys2048
methods.description: Returns a fixed 2048-bit RSA key pair for testing.

methods.name: GetAnotherStrongRsaKeys2048
methods.description: Returns another fixed 2048-bit RSA key pair for testing.

methods.name: GetStrongRsaKeys3072
methods.description: Returns a fixed 3072-bit RSA key pair for testing.

methods.name: GetStrongRsaKeys4096
methods.description: Returns a fixed 4096-bit RSA key pair for testing.

methods.name: GetIetfStandardRsaBlindSignatureTestVector
methods.description: Provides an IETF standard RSA blind signature test vector.

methods.name: GetIetfStandardRsaBlindSignatureTestKeys
methods.description: Provides RSA key pair for IETF test vectors.

methods.name: GetIetfRsaBlindSignatureWithPublicMetadataTestVectors
methods.description: Returns test vectors with public metadata for RSA blind signatures.

methods.name: GetIetfRsaBlindSignatureWithPublicMetadataTestKeys
methods.description: Provides RSA key pair for public metadata test vectors.

methods.name: RandomString
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length.
